***蛋白样本处理步骤（Metabolites Extraction）：***

Adding 300 μL water, the samples were vortexed for 30 s. The samples were precooled in dry ice, repeated freeze-thaw three times in liquid nitrogen. The samples were vortexed for 30s, and sonicated for 15 min in ice-water bath. A 250 μL aliquot of the clear supernatant was transferred to a new EP tube before a 1000 μL aliquot of the extract solvent (acetonitrile-methanol, 1:1, containing isotopically-labelled internal standard mixture, precooled at -40 ℃) was added. The remaining sample supernatant was measured for protein content. After incubation at -40 ℃ for one hour and centrifugation at 12000 rpm (RCF=13800(×g), R= 8.6cm) and 4 ℃ for 15 min, a 100 μL aliquot of the clear supernatant was transferred to an auto-sampler vial for UHPLC-MS/MS analysis.
